# Asura Bot

Asura Bot is a Discord bot with rooster collection, battles, raids, tournaments and progression by commands. The primary public website is in Brazilian Portuguese.

- Official website: https://asurabot.com.br/
- Rooster catalog: https://asurabot.com.br/galos
- Game information: https://asurabot.com.br/info
- Official documentation: https://docs.asurabot.com.br/
- Support community: https://discord.gg/CfkBZyVsd7

Use the catalog and official documentation for current game details. This file is optional context for agents and does not replace the website.
